Rahul P: FYI bringing Radiant14b into staging for basic evals — after q4f16 quant run we see token drift / decode mismatch vs fp16. Looks like KV state not lining up across rotary freq change :eyes:
Claire M: hmm. Saw similar with another model — when rotary base differs between tokenizer/model config the kv rotation math can desync after beam/streaming. Can you paste the quant config and the runtime flags?
Rahul P: here's the run command + model card excerpt:
```
./run_infer --model=rad_r14b --quant=q4f16 --rotary-base=10000 --seq-len=2048 --batch=1 --force-streaming
model_card:
  arch: gated-transformer-ish
  rotary_base: 10000
  kv_chunk: 256
```
Infra Bot: Automated canary deploy started: canary-id=canary-2134567890; routed 5% traffic to model-v1-quant. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/rad_r14b/canary-2134567890 (prod creds req)
Anya S: also check cached prefix eviction policy — if K/V cache uses chunked offsets we saw off-by-one when sequence_len truncated at boundary. Add `KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1` and repro with the exact prompt that ends near chunk boundary.
Rahul P: added debug logs, reproduced locally. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18 14:22:01] KV debug: kv_index_mismatch token_idx=1024 expected=1023
[2026-03-18 14:22:01] Rotary: rotary_freq=10000 model_cfg=8192 -> applied_interpolation=0.0007
[2026-03-18 14:22:01] Decode: nll_diff=0.25, top1_change=0.18
[2026-03-18 14:22:01] Perf: p50=120ms p95=310ms (baseline fp16 p50=85ms)
```
Lee T: quick hypothesis: quant kernel selection for matmul is picking a packed q4f16 kernel that assumes rotary freq aligned to power-of-two / interpolation-friendly profile -> small phase shift. Try re-running with `--force-kernel=fp16-matmul` to see if drift disappears.
Claire M: if that fixes it, we should add runtime compatibility tags to model catalog: `rotary-base`, `requires-nonpacked-kernel`, `kv-granularity`. I'll flag this P1 for onboarding blocker and add to the intake board. :exclamation:
Rahul P: running with `--force-kernel=fp16-matmul` now, will report back in ~10m. thanks all :pray:
